speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. To help me understand the cause of your acute diarrhea, can you tell me when your symptoms started and if you have experienced fever, blood in your stool, or severe abdominal pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-Associated Diarrhea (likely C. difficile infection). Given the recent levofloxacin use for pneumonia, I am requesting the C.diff toxin assay and electrolyte panel immediately.
